This page assembles the driver minifigure: helmet with visor, head, torso and legs. The minifigure parts (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded as pieces.
The only listed part on the page is the black wrench (lego-4006), which the minifigure holds. It is recorded as b1. The hand that holds it is not a listed part, so no join is recorded for it.
Assumption: the wrench counts as placed on this page, because it appears in the finished minifigure's hand.

Step 1: a black 1x6 plate (b2) is placed alone. Step 2: a black 4x4 plate with quarter-round cutout (b3) is added on top of one end of it. Step 3: a second black 1x6 plate (b4) is added along the other arm of the L.
Assumption: b4 sits on top of b3, so its rests_on is b3 only. The drawing could instead show b4 clutching b3 from below. In that case b3 would also rest on b4.
The small inset picture at the top left shows the finished sub-assembly. It is a preview, not a build step, and adds no pieces.
Step 4: a second black 4x4 plate with quarter-round cutout (b5) is added. It overlaps the free end of the 1x6 plate b4, which turns the frame into a U shape.
Step 5: a black 1x6 plate (b6) is added along the other arm. It is joined to b5 in the same way as b4 is joined to b3.
Assumption: b5 sits on top of b4, and b6 sits on top of b5, matching the stacking assumed on the previous page. The drawings do not show clearly whether any plate clutches from below.

Step 6 (2x): two black 1x2 plates (b7, b8) are added. The drawing shows them as a lower layer under the frame, so they are recorded as clutching the frame from below. They have rests_on [] because nothing is below them. This is a guess, since the drawing is hard to read.
Step 7: two white inverted curved 1x3x2 bricks (b9, b10) form the uprights at the ends of the arch. Two white 4x4 curved macaroni tiles (b11, b12) form the arch between them.
The exact plates that each arch piece sits on are estimated from the drawing.
Step 8 starts a new, separate sub-assembly, so b13 is a new first piece. Sub-step 1 uses the Technic 2x4 plate (b13).

Sub-step 2 turns the model over. It adds the 1x8 plate (b14) across the Technic plate and the round 2x2 tile with hole (b15) on the other side of the Technic plate. The drawing is ambiguous here. I recorded b14 as resting on b13 and the tile as joined to its underside.
Sub-step 3 adds the two curved parts that form the arch, shown over the 1x8 plate. I identified them as two lego-15068 curved 2x2 bricks (b16, b17). The icon in the parts box is hard to read.

The parts box also shows a gear (lego-32270), an axle pin (lego-18651) and a propeller (lego-92842). None of these is placed in sub-steps 1-3, so they are not recorded and will presumably be used on the next page.
Colours are taken from the parts list. The drawings render everything in grey tones.

Step 4 (the model is turned over twice, with rotate arrows): the black axle pin b18 is pushed through the hole in the round tile b15. The propeller b19 goes on the pin end. The 12-tooth gear b20 goes on the axle end on the other side.
The propeller is recorded as resting on the round tile b15.

The right-hand picture shows the finished sub-assembly: a black frame with the white arch, propeller and gear. An arrow carries it to the next page, where it will presumably be attached to the main model. No new pieces are added by that picture.
I assumed the axle pin freely turns in the tile hole, and that the propeller and gear are locked to the axle.
Step 9 (2x): two white inverted slopes 2x1 (b21, b22) are added at the feet of the arch, one on each white upright (b9, b10).
Step 10 (2x): two white cheese slopes (b23, b24) are pressed onto the open ends of the uprights (b9, b10). The model is turned over for this step.
Assumption: each slope rests only on its own upright. The exact attachment points are not clear in the drawings.

The join b14-b3 records the propeller sub-assembly (steps 8-9) being slotted into the black frame, as shown by the arrow on the previous page. I could not tell which frame plate it clutches, so b3 is a guess.

Group connection [L3]: the booklet really does build separate things, namely the driver minifigure with its wrench, the white-arch display stand (steps 1-10), and the McLaren Senna car. I kept them. To link them in the graph I added two contact joins. The wrench touches the wheel cover b205 (page 61 tip), and the car's tyre b202 touches the stand's base plate b2 when the car is parked on the stand.

Missing parts [L4]: I added the parts the checker listed as unplaced. These are two orange 1x2 plates (b218, b219), two 1x1 tiles (b220, b221), the black Technic 1x5 plate (b222), the dark bluish grey 2x6 plate (b223) and two white cheese slopes (b224, b225). Extra parts [L4]: lego-3666 x1, lego-35787 x4, lego-2420 x1 and lego-63864 x2 are over-counted against the parts list. These come from icon misreadings on pages 30, 17, 21, 44-45, 50-58 and similar. I cannot remove earlier pieces in an additions-only reply, so they stay. The likely real parts behind them are the Technic 1x5 plate (b222), plates and tiles of other types, so the over-count is a known identification error rather than a missing step.

Tile-support warnings [L5]: the warnings for b19, b28, b58, b59, b115, b123, b134, b135, b155, b157 and b163 come from my rests_on estimates in earlier steps, where I could not read from the drawings which studs each piece clutched. I cannot edit those lists here. I can say the real fixes are: the propeller b19 is held by the axle pin b18 through the tile hole, not by the tile; the 2x4 plate b28 and the triangle tiles b58, b59 sit on the base b25, not on the tile b27; and the plates and panels placed on tiles (b115, b123, b134, b135, b155, b157, b163) clutch the studs of the plates next to those tiles instead.

The pieces above are re-stated with the same ids and types as before. They replace the earlier entries for those ids, and only the rests_on lists have changed. Each piece now rests only on pieces that have studs.
b19 (propeller): it is held by the axle pin b18 through the pin hole, not by the round tile b15. Its rests_on is now empty. The existing pin join b18-b19 stays.
b28 (2x4 plate): it now rests only on the base b25. The grooved tile b27 has no studs, so it cannot hold b28.
